One will write only in the morning, another only at night, a third will be able to force himself into effort only at intervals, and a fourth will, after the manner of Anthony Trollope, be almost altogether independent of times and places.

arxiv-2206-02537.title: Gate-tunable anomalous Hall effect in a 3D topological insulator/2D magnet van der Waals heterostructure
arxiv-2206-02537.creator: Vishakha Gupta, Rakshit Jain, Yafei Ren, Xiyue S. Zhang, Husain F. Alnaser, Amit Vashist, Vikram V. Deshpande, David A. Muller, Di Xiao, Taylor D. Sparks, Daniel C. Ralph
arxiv-2206-02537.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Vishakha Gupta, Rakshit Jain, Yafei Ren, Xiyue S. Zhang, Husain F. Alnaser, Amit Vashist, Vikram V. Deshpande, David A. Muller, Di Xiao, Taylor D. Sparks, Daniel C. Ralph. I
Abstract

We demonstrate advantages of samples made by mechanical stacking of exfoliated
van der Waals materials for controlling the topological surface state of a 3-dimensional
topological insulator (TI) via interaction with an adjacent magnet layer.

arxiv-2302-10948.title: The pride of lions around Messier 105 2022 The pride of lions around Messier 105 – References
arxiv-2302-10948.creator: Igor D. Karachentsev, Elena I. Kaisina, Valentina E. Karachentseva
arxiv-2302-10948.description: Abstract We undertook a search for new dwarf galaxies in the Leo-I group using the data from the DECaLS digital sky survey. Five new presumed members of this group have been found in a wide vicinity of M ​ 105 ​ ( NGC ​ 3379 CLOSE {\rm M}\,105({\rm NGC}\,3379 ).

arxiv-2306-14391.title: On Positivity for the Peterson Variety Thanks: The author was supported in part by NSF Grant #2152312
arxiv-2306-14391.creator: Rebecca Goldin
arxiv-2306-14391.description: Abstract . We aim in this manuscript to describe a specific notion of geometric positivity that manifests in cohomology rings associated to the flag variety G / B G/B and, in some cases, to subvarieties of G / B G/B .

arxiv-2402-17924.title: Band structure and excitonic properties of WSe 2 in the isolated monolayer limit in an all-electron approach
arxiv-2402-17924.creator: Niloufar Dadkhah and Walter R. L. Lambrecht
arxiv-2402-17924.description: Abstract A study is presented of the electronic band structure and optical absorption spectrum of monolayer WSe 2 using an all-electron quasiparticle self-consistent G ​ W GW approach, QS G ​ W ^ G\hat{W} , in which the screened Coulomb interaction W ^ \hat{W} is calculated including ladder diagrams representing electron-hole interaction.

arxiv-2403-19426.title: A multi-step calibration strategy for reliable parameter determination of salt rock mechanics constitutive models Journal: International Journal of Rock Mechanics and Mining Sciences
arxiv-2403-19426.creator: Hermínio T. Honório, Maartje Houben, Kevin Bisdom, Arjan van der Linden, Karin de Borst, Lambertus J. Sluys, Hadi Hajibeygi
arxiv-2403-19426.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hermínio T. Honório, Maartje Houben, Kevin Bisdom, Arjan van der Linden, Karin de Borst, Lambertus J. Sluys, Hadi Hajibeygi. The storage of renewable hydrogen in salt caverns requires fast injection and production rates to cope with the imbalance between energy production and consumption. Such operational conditions raise concerns about the mechanical stability of salt caverns. Choosing an appropriate constitutive model for salt mechanics is an important step in investigating this issue, and many constitutive models with several parameters have been presented in the literature.

arxiv-2406-17061.title: AGN STORM 2: IX. Studying the Dynamics of the Ionized Obscurer in Mrk 817 with High-resolution X-ray Spectroscopy
arxiv-2406-17061.creator: Fatima Zaidouni, Erin Kara, Peter Kosec, Missagh Mehdipour, Daniele Rogantini, Gerard A. Kriss, Ehud Behar, Jelle Kaastra, Aaron J. Barth, Edward M. Cackett, Gisella De Rosa, Yasaman Homayouni, Keith Horne, Hermine Landt, Nahum Arav, Misty C. Bentz, Michael S. Brotherton, Elena Dalla Bontà, Maryam D
arxiv-2406-17061.description: Abstract We present the results of the XMM-Newton and NuSTAR observations taken as part of the ongoing, intensive multi-wavelength monitoring program of the Seyfert 1 galaxy Mrk 817 by the AGN Space Telescope and Optical Reverberation Mapping 2 (AGN STORM 2) Project. The campaign revealed an unexpected and transient obscuring outflow, never before seen in this source.

arxiv-2506-22547.title: MOSDEF-3D: Keck/OSIRIS Maps of the Ionized ISM in 𝐳 ∼ 𝟐 \bf{z\sim 2} Galaxies
arxiv-2506-22547.creator: Natalie Lam, Alice E. Shapley, Ryan L. Sanders, Tuan Do, Tucker Jones, Alison Coil, Mariska Kriek, Bahram Mobasher, Naveen A. Reddy, Brian Siana, Leonardo Clarke
arxiv-2506-22547.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Natalie Lam, Alice E. Shapley, Ryan L. Sanders, Tuan Do, Tucker Jones, Alison Coil, Mariska Kriek, Bahram Mobasher, Naveen A. Reddy, Brian Siana, Leonardo Clarke. We present spatially-resolved rest-frame optical emission line maps of four galaxies at z ∼ 2 z\sim 2 observed with Keck/OSIRIS to study the physical conditions of the ISM at Cosmic Noon.

arxiv-2507-12707.title: Splittable Spanning Trees and Balanced Forests in Dense Random Graphs
arxiv-2507-12707.creator: David Gillman, Jacob Platnick, Dana Randall
arxiv-2507-12707.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by David Gillman, Jacob Platnick, Dana Randall. Weighted equitable partitioning of a graph G G has been of interest lately due to several applications, including redistricting, network algorithms, and image decomposition. Equitably partitioning a graph according to the spanning-tree metric, which assigns a weight to each component equal to its number of spanning trees, and overall weight equal to the product of the weights of its components, has been of mathematical and practical interest because it typically favors partitions with more compact pieces.

arxiv-2509-25479.title: Discontinuous Epitope Fragments as Sufficient Target Templates for Efficient Binder Design
arxiv-2509-25479.creator: Zhenfeng Deng, Ruijie Hou, Ningrui Xie, Mike Tyers, Michał Koziarski
arxiv-2509-25479.description: Abstract Recent advances in structure-based protein design have accelerated de novo binder generation, yet interfaces on large domains or spanning multiple domains remain challenging due to high computational cost and declining success with increasing target size. We hypothesized that protein folding neural networks (PFNNs) operate in a “local-first” manner, prioritizing local interactions while displaying limited sensitivity to global foldability.

arxiv-2510-08267.title: Low-depth measurement-based deterministic quantum state preparation
arxiv-2510-08267.creator: Roselyn Nmaju, Fiona Speirits, Sarah Croke
arxiv-2510-08267.description: Abstract We present a low-depth amplitude encoding method for arbitrary quantum state preparation. Building on the foundation of an existing divide-and-conquer algorithm, we propose a method to disentangle the ancillary qubits from the final state. Our method is measurement-based but deterministic, and offers an alternative approach to existing state preparation algorithms.

arxiv-2601-03924.title: A low-complexity method for efficient depth-guided image deblurring
arxiv-2601-03924.creator: Ziyao Yi, Diego Valsesia, Tiziano Bianchi, and Enrico Magli
arxiv-2601-03924.description: Abstract Image deblurring is a challenging problem in imaging due to its highly ill-posed nature. Deep learning models have shown great success in tackling this problem but the quest for the best image quality has brought their computational complexity up, making them impractical on anything but powerful servers.

europmc-pmc4924075.creator: Cocker F, Joss N.
europmc-pmc4924075.description: Compassion fatigue (CF) is stress resulting from exposure to a traumatized individual. CF has been described as the convergence of secondary traumatic stress (STS) and cumulative burnout (BO), a state of physical and mental exhaustion caused by a depleted ability to cope with...

pmc-11303668.title: Accuracy and influencing factors of Type B2 vessels in predicting the invasion depth of superficial esophageal squamous cell carcinoma under narrow-band imaging magnifying endoscopy
pmc-11303668.creator: Xu Lin, Xiaolu Lin, Wei Liang, Wangyin Deng, Wenming Liu
pmc-11303668.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveTo evaluate the accuracy of Type B2 based on narrow-band imaging-magnifying endoscopy (NBI-ME) in judging invasion depth of superficial esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (SESCC) and analyze potential influencing factors.MethodData from 113 patients where Type B2 was observed by magnifying endoscopy and confirmed by postoperative pathology as SESCC at the First Affiliated Hospital of Fujian Medical University and Fujian Provincial Hospital from January 2015 to April 2024 were retrospectively analyzed.

pmc-11353188.title: Skeletal Muscle-Derived Stem Cell Transplantation Accelerates the Recovery of Peripheral Nerve Gap Injury under 50% and 100% Allogeneic Compatibility with the Swine Leucocyte Antigen
pmc-11353188.creator: Tetsuro Tamaki, Toshiharu Natsume, Akira Katoh, Atsuko Shigenari, Takashi Shiina, Nobuyuki Nakajima, Kosuke Saito, Tsuyoshi Fukuzawa, Masayoshi Otake, Satoko Enya, Akihisa Kangawa, Takeshi Imai, Miyu Tamaki, Yoshiyasu Uchiyama
pmc-11353188.description: Pig skeletal muscle-derived stem cells (SK-MSCs) were transplanted onto the common peroneal nerve with a collagen tube as a preclinical large animal experiment designed to address long nerve gaps. In terms of therapeutic usefulness, a human family case was simulated by adjusting the major histocompatibility complex to 50% and 100% correspondences.

pmc-11496843.title: Analysis of prognostic factors and construction of prognostic models for invasive lobular carcinoma of the breast
pmc-11496843.creator: Lin Cheng, Jianlin Wang, Liming Tang
pmc-11496843.description: Invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC) and invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) account for most cases of breast cancer. However, there is ongoing debate about any potential variations in overall survival (OS) between ILC and IDC. This study aimed to compare survival between IDC and ILC, identify prognostic factors for ILC patients, and construct a nomogram for predicting OS rates.

pmc-11510499.title: Mechanism-Based Allylic Carbasugar Chlorides That Form Covalent Intermediates with α- and β-Galactosidases
pmc-11510499.creator: Oluwafemi Akintola, Sandeep Bhosale, Andrew J Bennet, Indrajeet Sharma
pmc-11510499.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Glycoside hydrolases have been implicated in a wide range of human conditions including lysosomal storage diseases. Consequently, many researchers have directed their efforts towards identifying new classes of glycoside hydrolase inhibitors, both synthetic and from natural sources. A large percentage of such inhibitors are reversible competitive inhibitors that bind in the active site often due to them possessing structural features, often a protonatable basic nitrogen atom, that mimic the enzymatic transition state.

pmc-11600994.title: PM2.5 exposure and household income are associated with lung function abnormalities in children with sickle cell disease
pmc-11600994.creator: Jelte Kelchtermans, Julian Allen, Anita Bhandari
pmc-11600994.description: RationaleCardiopulmonary dysfunction is a major contributor to mortality among persons with sickle cell disease (pwSCD). Despite this, little is known regarding environmental drivers of lung function decline.ObjectiveWe hypothesized that environmental and socioeconomic variables have a significant effect on lung function in pwSCD that can be detected by spirometry.

pmc-12565513.title: Informal Mathematical Thinking: Invariance of the Role of Domain-General and Domain-Specific Precursors in Spain and Chile
pmc-12565513.creator: Gamal Cerda, Carlos Pérez, Eugenio Chandía, Estíbaliz Aragón, José I. Navarro
pmc-12565513.description: This study examines how domain-general (processing speed and receptive vocabulary) and domain-specific (symbolic and non-symbolic comparison) cognitive skills contribute to early informal mathematical thinking in preschoolers. The aim was to assess the invariance of these predictive relationships across two sociocultural contexts: Chilean and Spanish samples.

pmc-12803741.title: Positional Respiratory Distress in Myasthenic Crisis: A Case of Undiagnosed Thymoma
pmc-12803741.creator: Oscar Diaz, Noah M Krupnick, Yadaymis Hidalgo Jimenez, Lazaro Basart, Benjamin Graham, Evelin P Jimenez
pmc-12803741.description: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a chronic autoimmune neuromuscular disorder that can present with life-threatening complications, including myasthenic crisis (MC). We present the case of a 52-year-old Hispanic male with known MG who presented to a hospital serving an underserved community with respiratory distress after discontinuing azathioprine.

pmc-13058836.title: Base editing in the AUTS2 gene and high-throughput NGS genotyping of clones: a strategy for generating a cellular model
pmc-13058836.creator: A.P. Yan, P.A. Salnikov, А.А. Buzdin, V.А. Кovalskaia, E.V. Musatova, P.S. Orlov, О.P. Ryzhkova, A.I. Subbotovskaia, М.V. Suntsova, А.U. Khristichenko, А.А. Khabarova
pmc-13058836.description: Studying the molecular mechanisms underlying autism spectrum disorders (ASD) requires cellular models capable of capturing cis-regulatory effects and allele-specific gene expression. In this study, we present an approach for generating induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) modified using an adenine base editor (ABE) to introduce synonymous single-nucleotide substitutions in the AUTS2 gene – a candidate involved in ASD pathogenesis.

pmc-13344173.title: Cost-effectiveness of extracorporeal CPR for out-of-hospital cardiac arrest: a trial-based Markov model with a lifetime horizon
pmc-13344173.creator: Anina F van de Koolwijk, Andrea Gabrio, Thijs S R Delnoij, Martje M Suverein, Stijn E D M Eussen, Brigitte A B Essers, Annemieke Oude Lansink-Hartgring, Renicus C Hermanides, Luuk C Otterspoor, Carlos V Elzo Kraemer, Alexander P J Vlaar, Joris J van der Heijden, Erik Scholten, Corstiaan A den Uil, D
pmc-13344173.description: AimsExtracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation (ECPR) can restore circulation in refractory out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA). A trial-based analysis with a 1-year horizon showed limited cost-effectiveness of this demanding procedure. However, arguably, long-term incremental health benefits may justify high initial incremental costs. We assessed the cost-effectiveness of ECPR compared with conventional cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CCPR) for OHCA with a lifetime horizon using trial-based data.

pmc-13362700.title: From Tracks to Hotspots: Particle-Dependent Radiation Energy Deposition in MAPbI3 Perovskite
pmc-13362700.creator: Ivan E. Novoselov, Zhi Xing, Huiliang Sun, Ivan S. Zhidkov
pmc-13362700.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Geant4 (version 11.3.2) simulations were used to study particle-dependent radiation interaction in MAPbI3 under electron, photon, and neutron irradiation. The analysis focused on spatial distributions of interaction events, released energy, secondary-particle generation, and process-specific contributions. A 1 mm single-layer MAPbI3 target was used to identify the intrinsic material response, while multilayer MAPbI3 containing detector geometries were considered to assess device-like effects. Electrons produced extended charged particle tracks governed by direct energy loss and secondary-electron cascades.

pmc-13548016.title: Family Caregiving and Psychosocial Support in Hospice and Palliative Care: A Social Work Perspective
pmc-13548016.creator: Jung-won Lim
pmc-13548016.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Family caregiving and psychosocial support are essential components of high-quality hospice and palliative care. This review examined family caregiving and psychosocial support in hospice and palliative care from a social work perspective. Specifically, it reviewed the current evidence on family caregiving and psychosocial interventions for family caregivers, re-examined the evolving role of hospice social workers, and discussed implications for future research, practice, and policy in hospice social work.

pmc-13610526.title: Small-Size Graphene-Enabled Corrosion-Resistant Ultra-Thin Copper Foils Fabricated by Direct-Current Electrodeposition
pmc-13610526.creator: Zheng Yu, Hanyang Zhao, Junpeng Li, Jinzhong Li, Lixu Zhu, Xiaowen Zhang, Wenjuan Niu, Feng Wang, Kewang Zheng, Fei Zhong
pmc-13610526.description: The corrosion degradation of ultra-thin copper foils remains a critical challenge for maintaining their long-term structural stability under aggressive electrochemical environments. In this work, small-size graphene (sGr) was incorporated into ultra-thin copper foils through a direct-current electrodeposition strategy to improve corrosion resistance.

pmc-13678098.title: The central neurometabolic fingerprint of persistent spinal pain syndrome type 2: A prospective [18F]FDG PET/CT neuroimaging study
pmc-13678098.creator: Lara S Burmeister, Max van Grinsven, Bert-Kristian van Roosendaal, Richard L Witkam, Inge Arnts, Stephanie Janssen, Jessica Wegener, Kris CP Vissers, Anne IJ Arens, Martin Gotthardt, Michael Rullmann, Dylan Henssen
pmc-13678098.description: Persistent spinal pain syndrome type 2 (PSPS-T2) is a disabling pain condition that persists after spinal surgery. While spinal cord stimulation (SCS) offers symptomatic relief, objective biomarkers to guide diagnosis and treatment are lacking.In this prospective cohort study, fifteen PSPS-T2 patients underwent dedicated [18F]FDG PET/CT brain imaging prior to SCS implantation.
